r:
getrandom

Runs TPM2_GetRandom

-by
bytes requested
[-of
output file, with -nz, appends nul terminator (default do not save)]
[-nz
get random number with no zero bytes (for authorization value)]
[-ns
no space, no text, no newlines] just a string of hexascii suitable for a symmetric key

-se[0-2] session handle / attributes (default NULL)

01
continue
40
response encrypt
